name: Battle of Alberta 2026

venue.name: Cenovus Common, Red Deer Polytechnic
venue.address: 100 College Boulevard, Red Deer, Alberta, Canada T4N 5H5
venue.details: Upstairs in the Cenovus Learning Common

information:
Attendance is not required for the entire competition. However, **please arrive at least 15 minutes before the events that you compete in**. Please bring your own puzzles for the events you are competing in.

**First-Time Competitors: All newcomers must be familiar with the WCA Regulations before competing.** There is a video [here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww&t=2s&ab_channel=cyotheking) for a basic overview of the rules.
